Subject: POC next steps + prompt dataset / eval plan - Acme Health

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC so we stay aligned: 

Summary of goals:
- Validate Redwood inference throughput and latency for batch and streaming scenarios for your triage assistant model.
- Confirm model quality on your real prompts (safety + clinical extraction accuracy).
- Measure cost per 1k tokens and end-to-end latency under expected concurrency.

Success criteria (proposed):
1) Average 95th percentile latency < 600ms for interactive flows at 50 concurrent users.
2) Entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 on the provided evaluation set.
3) No PII leakage in model outputs for sample dataset.
4) End-to-end cost delta <= 30% vs your current baseline.

Immediate asks from Acme: one-off sample of prompts + ~1k anonymized prod examples (can be sanitized) and the top 20 failure cases you care about.

Proposed timeline:
- By Wed (5/20): Acme sends sample prompts + top failure cases.
- 5/21-5/27: Redwood runs prompt set eval + initial perf runs.
- 5/28: Mini demo of results + review of metrics; decision on extended trial.

Ownership:
- Acme: Jasmine (owner for prompt dataset & sanitized logs), Tom (procurement/exec).
- Redwood: Marissa (engagement owner), Priyom (SE lead), Aditya (inference tuning).

Attachments: I attached a short template CSV for prompt upload and the POC evaluation plan workbook we discussed. If you prefer a share link instead of attachments, we can create a shared Drive doc.

Thanks — looking forward to the sample prompts.

—

Hi Jasmine — really helpful dataset, thanks for sending. Quick technical plan / clarifications from the SE side: 

1) Evaluation environment: we can run the initial eval on Redwood Dedicated in a customer-dedicated tenant with encrypted storage and no external logging by default. If you prefer private VPC/on-prem, we can escalate and provide an Air-Gapped evaluation (adds ~3 business days to setup). Please confirm which you prefer.

2) Data handling: we will never store your raw prompts outside the Dedicated tenant for this POC. Derived evaluation metrics will be shared in a summary report only.

3) Prompt format: the CSV you provided looks good — one prompt per row with columns: prompt_id, prompt_text, context_tags, expected_labels, notes. I ran a quick spot-check and the encoding looks clean.

4) Evaluation plan (high level):
- Ingest sample prompts and run baseline models (open-weights A/B with quantization variants).
- Compute QA metrics (entity extraction F1, hallucination rate measured by string overlap heuristics).
- Perf run: synthetic concurrency to mirror 50 concurrent interactive users; measure P95 latency and tail behavior; repeat with batching configs.

5) Deliverables: initial eval report (metrics + top 20 failure examples) by 5/27; live walkthrough on 5/28.

Next steps for owners:
- Jasmine to confirm environment preference (Dedicated vs Private VPC) and provide any compliance forms.
- Marissa to confirm Redwood PO / trial contract if we need Dedicated reserved capacity.
- Aditya and I will schedule the perf runs once environment is provisioned.

Thanks — assigning action items in the attached workbook.

—
